display_long_description:
Make your HVAC training step into the future with the Skillveri HVAC Simulator Enterprise edition.

Experience a fully immersive training environment in advanced Mixed Reality which seamlessly blends virtual workpieces with your real surroundings. Inspect, repair, and maintain HVAC systems safely, repeatedly, without ever touching a live wire or wasting a single refrigerant canister.

Perform all actions naturally with your hands, just as in the real world - no controllers needed!

Make your trainees:
Physically operate HVAC components in 3D
Identify components in an expanded 360 degree 3D view
Make mistakes safely - no risk, damaging equipment, or wasting money
Train on multiple equipment without physically installing them
Learn at each one’s own pace, pause and repeat whenever needed

The Skillveri HVAC simulator recreates realistic scenarios and guides learners through complex tasks easily with step by step instructions.

This Enterprise version includes:
- Commercial HVAC cleaning
- Residential HVAC
- Leak Testing
- Brazing
- Vacuuming
- R32 Charging
- Blended Refrigerant Charging by weight
- Compound Refrigerant Charging
- Refrigerant Recovery

Ready to scale your training? To enable our HVAC simulator for your school or institution, contact us at usa@skillveri.com. Skillveri simulators are used by global industries and 100+ schools & colleges across the USA. Check out www.skillveri.com for more details.
For personal usage, check out Skillveri HVAC Simulator-Personal Use
